subject: podcast 9 lives forever...
author: drunknnumpty
body:
podcast 9 needs to stay on the front page of the criterion web site as long as possible, i dont mind waiting for 10 to come out even if it is delayed for a while so all the burnout fans get to hear the wonderful ZombieTron and Xandu...

just noticed that whenever I type Zom or Xan I typically write Xom and Zan, am I getting them comfused with XambieTron?? never mind...

so I will be saving a copy of Podcast 9 for prosparity and will be looking forward to playing it at the second burnout wedding sometime in the near future.. and maybe even keeping it to play to the little Xambies when they arrive...  lol..

 

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...

subject: Podcast 9 isn't the best...
author: FrozenVapor
body: That honor would go to Podcast 4 for being awesome, especially between from 40:00 onwards. My letters to Criterion are always the best.

subject: Thanks hn6!
author: ZombieTron
body:
If you didn't notice that we could have missed it completely!

I have made a front page story about the event now, and we have a release date and demo's announced too!! Too bad we weren't in London for the event, it sounds like it was kinda cool! 

Hopefully we will get a podcast about it later on today! I'm not holding my breath but I'm keeping my fingers crossed.

🙂 

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: Our Spell checking God, Alex has gone on Holiday.
author: SUFFUR
body:
Good podcast Guys (and where have you're women gone), enjoyed it alot, and some more infromation released nice. But seemed odd with out the man Alex, commanding the world of spelling, bad letters and dismissing questions of old (been covered in old cast's). I see drunk's was name drop city central, which is good, and I'll try that in the future, lol. At least the voice question is now clear, but it was not clear if it was room specific or world wide? Good cast, now maybe if we don't send questions, they will do a show? lol.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
